mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 47 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School, with the third quarter moon visible.

The City of Verona has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month, honoring the Planning and Development Department for their work on housing, transportation, and land use. Also, please note that a section of Highway M will be closed from October 6 through October 9 for road work.

There is plenty to do, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today. Tomorrow, you can head to the Capitol Square for the Dane County Farmers Market or catch the music series at Paddy Mac's.
In a noteworthy call from September 21, a suspect was identified through surveillance footage and cited for the retail theft of candy from a local retailer.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM to serve you.
